aboutParagraphs: Hi! I'm Deepsikha Pramanick, a Data Science & AI undergraduate student interested in computational approaches to scientific and engineering problems.

My academic path has crossed mathematics, physics, engineering and data science and artificial intelligence as I find it fascinating to explore solutions to real world problems with interdisciplinary approaches.
I am currently a third-year student pursuing a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence at the Mehta Family School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, IIT Guwahati.

I am currently working under the supervision of Dr. Rajiv Kumar Kar [Assistant Professor, Jyoti and Bhupat Mehta School of Health Sciences & Technology; Associate Faculty, Centre for Nanotechnology; Visiting Faculty, CoN, AIIMS Guwahati].
My work explores computational and data-driven approaches to problems spanning scientific computing, molecular systems, machine learning, signal processing and engineering.

news.title: Attended One Health Ideathon at JBMSHST, IITG
news.description: Grateful to attend One Health Ideathon at Jyoti and Bhupat Mehta School of Health Sciences and Technology, IIT Guwahati and presented my project "LOCUS : Localized Optimization of Controlled Antimicrobial Use & Systems" — localized, controlled antimicrobial delivery using chitosan hydrogels to concentrate treatment at the infection site while reducing unnecessary antimicrobial exposure to unaffected tissues and the surrounding environment—guided by quantitative analysis of experimental literature which was created under the supervision of Dr. Rajiv Kumar Kar sir.

news.title: My First International Conference
news.description: Went to my first international conference, MFF CARE Conference at Mehta Family School of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, IIT Guwahati and presented my poster titled "Adaptive AI Pipeline for RNA 3D Structure Prediction and Drug Discovery"
